config.design: Exact full2x2x2 finite factorial on96 heldout copy prompts. Bit1 donor final-position block9 residual; bit2 donor attention output final position every layer10-17; bit4 donor normalized MLP input final position every layer10-17. Same input and suffix, donor second task wording. All masks retained. Full combination recovery check; native final-token x0 equal asserted.
config.limitations: Exact heldout donor states; localization controls not predictors or compact surrogate. Hybrid states need not be naturally realizable. KL, CE and correctness separate; factorial improvements are not causal shares.
